lines.2: 「What a refreshing start to the day.」
lines.5: 「Someone I don't get along with is up ahead.」
lines.6: 「Konoe? Don't sweat it. Pretend she's a pumpkin.」
lines.7: 「Every once in a great while, you say something kind of cool.」
lines.8: 「I'm cool every second of every day!」
lines.13: 「Phew. Iron-senpai really is so dignified and cool.」
lines.14: 「What a great way to start the morning.」
lines.18: Otome fixed it for me, awkwardly but kindly.
lines.19: 「...Iron-senpai, why would you do that for someone like him...?」
lines.21: 「...Yeah. I can feel that stare pretty clearly.」
lines.25: But her hands got gentler as she tied my laces.
lines.26: For now, I decided to ignore Konoe's stare.
